value.rules_markdown:
- One responsibility per module, core types in a module-local types.rs, every port in src/ports/ is one trait in one file.
- Every subcommand in the CLI is declared even when its milestone has not landed.
- A preset is a folder with preset.toml, README.md, and optional prompt overrides; never a new module.
- Never edit the vendor/tinyagents submodule here; change it upstream and bump the pin.
- docs/modules/<module>/README.md is one document per src/ module.
- examples are declared in Cargo.toml with required-features, so credential-needing smoke tests never build in CI.
- rustfmt output, Rust 2024 idioms. snake_case modules and files, PascalCase types.
- Return Result<T> using the crate error type from src/error.rs.
- Every file opens with a //! module doc describing its role and any feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code; for load-bearing flags or ordering, say why.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use ///.
- Tests live in-crate: a #[cfg(test)] mod tests block at the bottom of the module, moving to a sibling test.rs when they grow; no tests/ directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock; MockForge records writes for exact assertions.
- Lane behaviour is covered by golden tests: fixture diff plus canned structured model response.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- The model never holds a write token; write credentials are minted only in src/apply/ after every model call returns.
- Contributor code is never executed; we read the diff and the tree, we do not build, install dependencies, or run the target repository's scripts.
- Pull request bodies, comments, diffs are untrusted input; fence and label them as data in prompts.
- Only deterministic policy in src/apply/ and src/automerge/ may mutate GitHub.
- Secrets found by the scanners are reported by type and location only, not in any output.
- Use concise imperative commit subjects; keep commits small and coherent.
- Pull requests state what changed, any behaviour change, and how it was verified.
- Tests live in-crate; no tests/ directory.
- Network needs go behind a feature (harness, github, serve).
- Default build is offline; no HTTP client in default build, test suite never touches network.
